guidance: Act3 floor34 MAP, Ironclad HP91/91, gold114, Sai relic (+7 Block each turn), Pumpkin Candle (+1 energy for 5 more combats), deck has Pyre, Barricade, Vicious, Uppercut+, Rampage, Hatchet, Expect a Fight, Colossus. Choose right branch row1/col5 Monster (map action option1), because it can reach row2/col4 Unknown, row3/col4 Unknown, row6/col4 Rest, row7/col4 Treasure and a later elite-avoiding path. Combat: protect HP. Sai gives recurring opening Block; if Barricade is drawn, play it only when immediate incoming damage remains safely covered because it costs3, then retained Block from Sai/Cloak Clasp/Expect compounds. Use Weak from Uppercut and Vulnerable for Colossus mitigation; do not repeatedly attack a single low-HP enemy if it gives a dangerous survivor buff. Use Liquid Bronze potion if it materially saves HP or helps a difficult fight, not merely to empty a slot. Take reward cards only when they improve defense, draw, energy, or reliable scaling for Act3 boss; otherwise skip. Stop on next MAP floor35, at HP<=40 before spending energy, terminal state, or budget.
